source: Despite the physical toll, Standers tend to earn less money.

source: And Sitters get more autonomy. These are workers who say they can pause work when they need to.

source: Hispanic workers are far more likely to be Standers

source: White workers are more likely to be Sitters. But they account for the majority of the workforce, so they're also the largest group of Standers.
claim: The mean white share is 75.3% in sitter occupations and 74.1% in stander occupations, and white is the largest racial group among stander occupations, ahead of Hispanic (19.5%), Black (11.4%) and Asian (4.7%).
